components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #9F1239; color: #fff; padding: 16px 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #881337; }

components.name: Ghost Dark Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); padding: 16px 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: Face Rating sits in the same visual category as The Face Report: frosted header, near-black hero, Inter Black, one rose italic.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: At most one italic serif word per heading.

dos: Do keep the four hero proof lines verbatim.
Do leave the left-face animation untouched.
donts: Don't reintroduce gold paper or lightbox/LED experiments.
Don't invent user scores or user counts.
